title: Peer-facing HTTP errors are plain English text (some Rust Display verbatim); use RFC 9457 problem+json with type URIs
description: Sweep 2026-11-14. crates/mimid-server/src/http.rs returns text/plain English bodies to peer providers: 'undecodable request' (L277, L469, L531), 'missing or malformed From header' (L447), 'invalid room ID', 'unknown user', 'path domain is not this provider', 'request body too large', 'no such room', '{endpoint} is not implemented', 'a reported message's frank does not verify', 'peer provider failed', 'internal error'; and error.to_string() at L359/L495 (follower/mod.rs:485, :489) and violation.to_string() at L475/L479 (follower/consent.rs:54-65). Readers are likely peer operators, not end users. Suggest RFC 9457 problem+json with a type URI per condition so the text is advisory, and no Rust Display text on the wire.
close_reason: problem+json with tag: type URIs, no title/detail (commit ce3df56)
